usdcny.title: USD/CNY spot exchange rate
usdcny.transform: None. Quoted as yuan per US dollar (direct quote from a US perspective).

reer.title: RMB real effective exchange rate (broad)
reer.source: Bank for International Settlements, Effective exchange rate indices (64 economies)
reer.transform: None. CPI-based real index; trade-weighted vs 63 partners.

neer.title: RMB nominal effective exchange rate (broad)
neer.source: Bank for International Settlements, Effective exchange rate indices (64 economies)

policy_cn.title: China policy rate
policy_cn.source: BIS central bank policy rates (People's Bank of China)
policy_cn.transform: BIS series = 1-year Loan Prime Rate since Aug 2019 (official 1-year lending rate before).

policy_us.title: US policy rate
policy_us.source: BIS central bank policy rates (Federal Reserve)

cpi_cn.title: China CPI inflation
cpi_cn.source: OECD Consumer prices (national source: NBS China)

cpi_us.title: US CPI inflation
cpi_us.source: OECD Consumer prices (national source: US BLS)

prod_cn.title: China labour productivity growth
prod_cn.source: World Bank WDI (SL.GDP.PCAP.EM.KD, ILO modelled estimates)
prod_cn.transform: Growth of GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP$), computed from levels.

prod_us.title: US labour productivity growth
prod_us.source: World Bank WDI (SL.GDP.PCAP.EM.KD, ILO modelled estimates)
prod_us.transform: Growth of GDP per person employed (constant 2021 PPP$), computed from levels.

pmi.title: China official manufacturing PMI
pmi.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China / CFLP

gdp.title: China real GDP growth
gdp.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China, Preliminary accounting results of GDP
gdp.transform: Year-on-year growth for the quarter, as published by NBS.

uip_implied.title: UIP-implied change in USD/CNY (from 10Y yield gap)

realised_12m.title: Realised change in USD/CNY over the following 12 months
realised_12m.source: Derived from Fed H.10 (monthly mean of daily rates)
realised_12m.transform: Mean USD/CNY in month t+12 vs month t. Positive = RMB weakened.
